Vampire.name: Vampire
Vampire.physicalDescription: Pale skin, fanged teeth, red eyes, aristocratic appearance, casts no reflection
Vampire.powers: Shapeshifting (bat, wolf, mist), Hypnosis, Superhuman strength, Immortality
Vampire.origin: Bitten by another vampire, Dying in sin, Improper burial, Suicide
Vampire.weaknesses: Sunlight, Garlic, Holy water, Crosses, Silver, Wooden stake through heart, Running water
Vampire.feedingMethod: Biting the neck, draining blood of living victims at night
Vampire.culturalContext: Rooted in Eastern European fear of the undead and disease outbreaks; popularized in Western culture by Bram Stoker's Dracula (1897)
Vampire.sources: Bram Stoker's Dracula, Vampyre by John Polidori (1819)

Abchanchu.name: Abchanchu
Abchanchu.physicalDescription: Appears as a elderly man, occasionaly fat if it recently ate. It has tattered clothes and comes off as fake friendly with a smile
Abchanchu.origin: They always existed as a demon
Abchanchu.feedingMethod: It disguises itself as a weary traveller, and preys on those who help it. Once the victim helps it, it drinks their blood, and drags their souls to it's caves
sources: López, Juan Antonio Sanz (2020-08-25). Vampiros, Príncipes del Abismo: Un Tratado Inusual Sobre Vampirismo: La Crónica Definitiva de la Búsqueda y Explicación de Este Fenómeno (in Spanish). Arcopress. ISBN 978-84-17828-86-8.

Antawalla.name: Antawalla (Lari Lari)
Antawalla.physicalDescription: It has the face of cat, but the body of an eagle. Can be seen on fire and it's appearance is accompanied by a bright flash of light
Antawalla.feedingMethod: Its voice and song has the power to put its victims to sleep, where it then steals their blood and soul. It is also known to steal newborns to drink their blood.
sources: López, Juan Antonio Sanz (2020-08-25). Vampiros, Príncipes del Abismo: Un Tratado Inusual Sobre Vampirismo: La Crónica Definitiva de la Búsqueda y Explicación de Este Fenómeno (in Spanish). Arcopress. ISBN 978-84-17828-86-8.
Journal de la Société des Americanistes, from 1998

Abere.name: Abere
Abere.physicalDescription: Siren-like creature with a lower half of a fish and upper half of a woman
Abere.feedingMethod: She lives in marshes and lures men towards her with her voice, then drags them into the water and slashes their throats with a shell. She then feeds on the blood and eats the flesh.

Adze.name: Adze
Adze.physicalDescription: In human form they are hunchbacked with talons and jet-black skin. They can also shapeshift into insects, most commonly fireflies and mosquitos
Adze.feedingMethod: They transform into insects and sneak into a household. They would suck the blood from their sleeping victims, making them sick. The effects are similar to that of malaria.
Adze.culturalContext: These vampires come from a fear of  insect-borne diseases like maleria

Algul.name: Algul
Algul.physicalDescription: Is a jinn, an evil spirit who appears as a woman.
Algul.feedingMethod: Lures in travellers by mimic the cries of someone wounded. Targets children specifically.

Alp.name: Alp
Alp.physicalDescription: Small humanoid creature who wears a white hat
weaknesses: Placing shoes at the edge of your bed, facing the door
Making it count a bag of seeds
Asking it to return the following morning for coffee
Alp.feedingMethod: It first appears in it's victim's dreams, then as it manifests physically it gives many symptoms of sleep paralysis. It eventually drinks the victim's blood, typically through their breast.

Angiak.name: Angiak
Angiak.physicalDescription: It looks the child that was abandoned
Angiak.origin: When a mother abandons her child and leaves it in the frozen plains, the child's soul can return to it's body and reanimate
Angiak.feedingMethod: It sneaks into it's family's home and nurse from it's mother to gain strength. It eventually shapeshifts and kills it's family.

Aniukha.name: Aniukha
Aniukha.physicalDescription: While it's size varies from insect to rabbit sized, it's a small creature that moves on all four limbs. It has plated skin with patches of thich brown fur. It has huge black eyes, pointed ears, and a snout.
Aniukha.feedingMethod: It tricks young children and ill people

Asanbosam.name: Asanbosam
Asanbosam.physicalDescription: It has iron teeth and long hair with long hooked claws for feet. They often are portayed with batlike features, like 20 feet wide wings.
Asanbosam.feedingMethod: It perches in the trees and hunts people trespassing it's territory. They lunge down and drag their prey upwards with tehir talon-like limbs.

Asema.name: Asema
Asema.physicalDescription: During the day, they look like an elderly person. At night they look like a blazing fireball
Asema.origin: If an asema draws too much blood from their victim, they could turn into one themself
Asema.feedingMethod: At night, they strip their skin off and leave it behind to hunt. They fly through the air as a fireball and enter homes to suck the blood of their victims, leaving them with bruises the day after. It targets the same victims night after night

Asiman.name: Asiman
Asiman.physicalDescription: The asiman is a vampiric witch that can remove their skin to turn into a corpse candle.
weaknesses: Killing it in it's animal form
Asiman.feedingMethod: It flies through the air to hunt

Baobhan Sith.name: Baobhan Sith
Baobhan Sith.physicalDescription: The baobhan sith is a vampiric fay. They look like beautiful women with deer hooves. They'll often wear long green dresses to hide their legs.
Baobhan Sith.origin: Created when a woman dies in childbirth
Baobhan Sith.feedingMethod: They lure men into secluded places and offer to dance with them. They'll continue to dance until the man is exhausted, when it attacks.

Bezkost.name: Bezkost
Bezkost.physicalDescription: Often referred to as a 'boneless vampire' it resembles a meaty sack. It fills up with blood while it's feeding.
Bezkost.feedingMethod: It can squeeze it's body into homes and feeds off the victims with cartilaginous teeth.
sources: Bestiariusz Słowiański by Paweł Zych and Witold Vargas

Blut Aussauger.name: Blut Aussauger
Blut Aussauger.physicalDescription: It has pale waxy skin and large eyes. It has no skeletal system and is hairy.
Blut Aussauger.origin: It carries dirt from it's tomb with it. When it wants to convert a vampire it force feeds them the dirt.
sources: Bane, Theresa (2020). Encyclopedia of Vampire Mythology. Jefferson, North Carolina. ISBN 978-1-4766-8177-1. OCLC 1140167340.

Boo Hag.name: Boo Hag
Boo Hag.physicalDescription: During the day it looks like an old woman with red eyes, but at night it sheds it's skin. When it's hunting it looks like a bloody mess of a humanoid with blue and red veins showing from it's body.
Boo Hag.origin: Witches who sold their soul to the devil
weaknesses: Cayenne pepper and salt mixture, The color haint blue painted onto surfaces (See picture)
Boo Hag.feedingMethod: They feed off a person's breath by breaking into the victim's home and riding them as they sleep, similar to sleep paralysis

Boraro.name: Boraro
Boraro.physicalDescription: The boraro has pale skin with black fur and is close to tree height in size. It has backwards facing feet, fangs, and massive genitalia.
Boraro.feedingMethod: If it catches a victim it crushes them in an embrace until their flesh is pulp. It then drinks their blood through small holse made in their body. Also, it's urine is poisonous.

Brahmaparush.name: Brahmaparush
Brahmaparush.physicalDescription: While looking typically vampiric, they stand out for their gruesome trophies they take from victims. They wear the intenstines of those they kill around themselves like necklaces and crowns. They're also known to carry a human skull and use it as a drinking cup.
Brahmaparush.feedingMethod: The brahmaparush kills in an almost ritualistic manner. It first nibbles a small hole from their victim to drink their blood. Then, it gnaws at the skull to eat their brains. Finally, it does a dance around the corpse as it puts on their intenstines.

Burach-Bhaoi.name: Burach-Bhaoi
Burach-Bhaoi.physicalDescription: It's a massive muscular eel fae between 3 and 6 feet in length. It blends into the muddle floors of its loch with its smooth, slimy, brown skin. It has nine eyes along it's head and spine.
Burach-Bhaoi.feedingMethod: It waits for prey to get near the edge of the water before coiling itself around them, drowning them while it feeds.

Camazotz.name: Camazotz
Camazotz.physicalDescription: It's a vampiric vampire god. It's depicted as a man-bat creature with a knife in one hand and a human sacrifice in the other.
Camazotz.feedingMethod: It attacks and decapitates humans after leaving its cave at night

Catacano.name: Catacano
Catacano.physicalDescription: This vampire smiles all the time
Catacano.origin: It creates more of itself by regurgitating blood onto it's victim.
weaknesses: Decapitating it's head and boiling it in vinegar, trapping it behind saltwater, burning its nails off.

Cãoera.name: Cãoera
Cãoera.physicalDescription: Giant bat the size of a vulture
Cãoera.feedingMethod: It lives in holes in the ground, coming out when it smells burning or nearby people. It can drain an entire person of their blood as they sleep.

Capelobo.name: Capelobo
Capelobo.physicalDescription: It looks like an anteater, but larger and bipedal. It has claws and perfectly round hooves
Capelobo.feedingMethod: It can stun creature with its smell. While they do not actively hunt humans, if they catch one, they will tightly grab them and suck their brains out through the top of the skull.

Chedipe.name: Chedipe
Chedipe.physicalDescription: The chedipe is a vulgar woman riding a tiger at night
Chedipe.origin: They are created when a women dies an unnatural death, such as in childbirth or suicide. Most often it is prostitutes who become Chedipe
Chedipe.feedingMethod: It places all inhabitants of a home in a deep sleep, then drains the blood of all men int he house by biting a hole in their big toe

Children of Judas.name: Children of Judas
Children of Judas.physicalDescription: Believed to be direct descendants of Judas Iscariot, all vampires of this type have red hair.
Children of Judas.feedingMethod: They are able to drain their victims blood with a single kiss (Their bites are often refered to as kisses). When they kiss their victim, they leave behind a scar that looks like Roman numerals 30 (XXX) to signify the 30 pieces of silver given to Judas for betray Christ.

Chonchon.name: Chonchon
Chonchon.physicalDescription: Flying head with wings in it ears. It's cry sounds like "tui-tui-tui". Invisible to most

Chupacabra.name: Chupacabra
Chupacabra.region: Originated in Puerto Rico, spread to Mexico and U.S.
Chupacabra.physicalDescription: Descriptions of the chupacabra vary greatly. In Puerto Rico and Hispanic America it's most commonly described as a small reptilian alien looking creature with a row of spines going from neck to tail. However in Southwestern United States its more like a hairless dog with pronouced eye sockets, fangs, and claws.
Chupacabra.feedingMethod: It uses its stealth to sneak up an animals, killing them quickly and draining them of all blood and leaving 3 puncture wounds.

Churel.name: Churel
Churel.physicalDescription: They are described as extremely ugly with backwards feet, a black tongue, rough skin, and wild hair. they can occasionally shapeshift into a beautiful women
Churel.origin: When a woman dies of unnatural causes during the Festival of Diwali
Churel.feedingMethod: They seduce young men, then drain them of their blood turning them into old men.

Danag.name: Danag
Danag.physicalDescription: A once peaceful vampire that actually coexisted with mankind. They are credited with the first to cultivate the taro plant.
Danag.origin: One day, a woman cut her finger and the Danag offered to suck it for her. They then realized they loved the taste of blood and drained her dry.

Dearg-Due.name: Dearg-Due
Dearg-Due.physicalDescription: They are a beautitul yet pale looking woman who stroll aimlessly in graveyard.
weaknesses: It's grave must be found and a cairn (Pile of rocks) must be erected on it.
Dearg-Due.feedingMethod: It seduces men and kisses them, draining their blood.

Edimmu.name: Edimmu
Edimmu.physicalDescription: Ghostlike in appearance, almost completely incorpearal almost like the wind.
Edimmu.origin: They are created when burial procedures are not followed.
Edimmu.feedingMethod: They suck the life out of sleeping people. They can also spread diease and inspire crime.

Empusa.name: Empusa
Empusa.physicalDescription: One-legged, with a singular donkey's leg and a prosthetic bronze one.
Empusa.origin: They are the daughters of Hecate
Empusa.feedingMethod: Convinces men to have sex with them and drains their life in the process.

Ekek.name: Ekek
Ekek.physicalDescription: Birdlike humanoid creatures. Makes an 'ek-ek-ek' sound while hunting.
Ekek.feedingMethod: They hunt for sleeping pregnant women, then extend a long proboscis into the womb and drink the fetus' blood.

Estries.name: Estries
Estries.physicalDescription: It's a noncorporeal mass of evil that can take the form of a human woman
weaknesses: If it's ever seen by a human it must eat their bread and salt or else it will lose its powers.
Estries.feedingMethod: It lives in communities to ensure it always has blood, engaging in sexual activity to drain their victims.

Encourado.name: Encourado
Encourado.physicalDescription: He wears black leathes clothes and always smells like blood. roosters stop crowing as he nears, dogs howl.
Encourado.feedingMethod: Feeds on animal and human blood, perferring the blood of people who don't go to church.

Gaki.name: Gaki
Gaki.physicalDescription: Cold hollow features and pale skin. Enourmous stomach and narrow neck
Gaki.origin: Created when an incredibly greedy person dies
Gaki.feedingMethod: Just being near a Gaki is enough for it to drain you. They chatter incomprehensibly until they actually attack.

Glaistig.name: Glaistig
Glaistig.physicalDescription: It's a vampiric fay that wears a green dress to hide its goat legs.
Glaistig.feedingMethod: It waits for a man to come too close to the water, then shapeshifts into a beautiful woman. It them pretends to be drowning and attacks them once they come to help.

Gwrach y Rhibyn.name: Gwrach y Rhibyn
Gwrach y Rhibyn.physicalDescription: Vampiric fay that has two different forms. The first is a hunchback figure that has nothing but darkness under its green cloak. The other is a creature so hideous under the cloak it drives madness to anyone who looks at it. It has a constant stream of drool from its mouth, a hooked nose, clawed limbs, and large bat wings at its side.
Gwrach y Rhibyn.feedingMethod: It attacks people who sleep and drains their blood. It only takes enough so they are unable to fully recover.

Habergeiss.name: Habergeiss
Habergeiss.physicalDescription: It's a three-legged demon bird. Occasionaly it is described as a hybrid of goats and birds.
Habergeiss.feedingMethod: It attacks cattle at night by disguising itself as different animals
